nodes.hypothesis: Morgan Stanley appears to be prioritizing operating leverage and cost discipline, as the efficiency ratio improved in FY 2024 and remained near that level in 2025 while management outlined further efficiency improvement.
nodes.label: Firmwide efficiency and expense discipline

nodes.statement: Morgan Stanley reported a full-year 2024 expense efficiency ratio of 71%, compared with 77% in the prior year.
Morgan Stanley attributed its improved 2024 expense efficiency ratio to higher revenues and expense discipline.
Morgan Stanley reported an expense efficiency ratio of 71% in Q2 2025.
Morgan Stanley reported a full-year 2024 expense efficiency ratio of 71%, versus 77% in the prior year.
Morgan Stanley said its improved 2024 expense efficiency ratio reflected higher revenues and expense discipline.
Morgan Stanley’s 4Q25 strategic update targets a 70% efficiency ratio.

nodes.hypothesis: Morgan Stanley appears to be continuing its integrated firm model, linking Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Institutional Securities under a unified client and platform strategy with active board oversight.
nodes.label: Integrated wealth and platform strategy

nodes.statement: Morgan Stanley’s 2025 shareholder letter says the firm will serve clients through an Integrated Firm model combining Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Institutional Securities.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 shareholder letter says the firm is supported by four pillars: strategy, culture, financial strength, and growth.
Morgan Stanley’s proxy statement says the board oversees the company’s strategy, capital, and annual business plans.
Morgan Stanley’s proxy statement says the board conducts an annual strategy offsite with the CEO and senior management.
Morgan Stanley’s board governance policies page says the board oversees the company’s strategic, capital, and annual business plans.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 proxy statement says board evaluation led to enhancements in executive succession planning.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 proxy statement says the board prioritized agendas for strategy, regulatory matters, and key risks.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 proxy materials page notes substantial board refreshment.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 proxy materials page says the board has an independent lead director with expansive duties.
Morgan Stanley’s 2025 proxy materials page says lead director and committee chairs are expected to serve about three to five years to rotate leadership.
